name: Autonomous driving and navigation
gist: Papers solving the problem of making vehicles and robots navigate safely through complex, changing environments using perception and planning—the challenge is handling occlusion, uncertainty, and multi-agent scenarios.
explain: Autonomous vehicles have to make split-second decisions in complex environments. A car is driving down a street and sees a pedestrian stepping between parked cars. It has to predict whether the person will continue into the street, estimate how much time it has to react, and decide to brake or swerve. A delivery robot navigating a warehouse has to move around people, obstacles, and other robots while carrying fragile packages. These are all navigation problems: how do you sense the world, predict how it will change, and decide where to move next?

The core difficulty is uncertainty and partial information. The robot's sensors do not see everything—some things are blocked (occluded). People and other objects behave unpredictably. The robot has to make a decision now, but the consequences play out over the next few seconds, and those consequences depend on the behavior of other agents in the world. Predicting whether a person will step into traffic requires modeling human intent, which is not visible. Planning a path for a car is easy in empty space; the complexity comes from other agents, uncertain obstacles, and the need to make decisions in real time. Also, any mistake can be costly—hitting a person or another vehicle is not an acceptable failure mode.

Papers tackle this by combining perception (seeing the world), prediction (guessing what others will do), and planning (choosing a safe trajectory). Some use neural networks to learn end-to-end: camera images map directly to steering and acceleration commands, trained on human driving data. Some build explicit models of the world—tracking where other cars and people are, predicting their future positions—and then use planning algorithms to find a safe path. Others combine the two: use neural networks to extract features from the scene, feed those to a planning algorithm that is aware of the robot's constraints (can only turn so fast, takes time to brake). Recent work emphasizes multi-agent reasoning—modeling not just one other agent, but the interaction between many agents—because traffic is a game where everyone is making decisions based on what they expect others to do.

papers.title: GT-Space: Enhancing Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception with Ground Truth Feature Space
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines in detection accuracy on OPV2V, V2XSet simulation datasets and RCooper real-world dataset.

papers.title: JanusVLN: Decoupling Semantics and Spatiality with Dual Implicit Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA on VLN with 10.5-35.5% success rate improvements over recent methods by enabling efficient long-term trajectory modeling with compact implicit representations.

papers.title: OccDriver: Future Occupancy Guided Dual-branch Trajectory Planner in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: OccDriver achieves state-of-the-art on nuPlan in both Non-Reactive and Reactive closed-loop performance.

papers.title: UrbanVerse: Scaling Urban Simulation by Watching City-Tour Videos
papers.contribution: Provides 160 high-quality scenes across 24 countries with strong zero-shot sim-to-real transfer improving success by +30.1% and enabling 300 m real-world mission.

papers.title: VADv2: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Probabilistic Planning
papers.contribution: VADv2 achieves state-of-the-art closed-loop performance on CARLA Town05 benchmark, significantly outperforming existing methods and demonstrating effectiveness on NAVSIM and 3DGS-based benchmarks.

papers.title: ARINBEV: Bird's-Eye View Layout Estimation with Conditional Autoregressive Model
papers.contribution: ARINBEV achieves 64.3 and 65.6 mIoU on nuScenes and Argoverse2 while using 1.7x fewer parameters and training 1.8x faster than state-of-the-art models.

papers.title: All-day Multi-scenes Lifelong Vision-and-Language Navigation with Tucker Adaptation
papers.contribution: AlldayWalker learns continuously across multiple scenarios, outperforming SOTA baselines on multi-scene lifelong VLN.

papers.title: BridgeDrive: Diffusion Bridge Policy for Closed-Loop Trajectory Planning in Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on Bench2Drive benchmark, improving success rate by 7.72% over prior work.

papers.title: Detecting Temporal Misalignment Attacks in Multimodal Fusion for Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: AION achieves high AUROC (0.9493 camera, 0.9495 LiDAR) against temporal misalignment attacks on KITTI and nuScenes.

papers.title: DriveMamba: Task-Centric Scalable State Space Model for Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: DriveMamba demonstrates superior performance on nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets, achieving efficient long-context token modeling for end-to-end autonomous driving.

papers.title: FlowAD: Ego-Scene Interactive Modeling for Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: FlowAD demonstrates generality and effectiveness across perception and planning tasks in both open and closed-loop evaluations.

papers.title: Hydra-Nav: Object Navigation via Adaptive Dual-Process Reasoning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on HM3D (11.1%), MP3D (17.4%), and OVON (21.2%) benchmarks, introduces SOT metric showing adaptive reasoning enhances search efficiency.

papers.title: Instruction Decomposition and Action Alignment for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across major benchmarks with improved robustness; includes 160K-image Instruction-Aligned Navigation Dataset.

papers.title: Joint Navigation and Manipulation Planning with 3D Interaction Chains
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent gains in both task success and trajectory efficiency on simulation and real Stretch 3 robot experiments.

papers.title: M$^3$E: Continual Vision-and-Language Navigation via Mixture of Macro and Micro Experts
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms fine-tuning and continual learning baselines on R2R and REVERIE domain-incremental settings, offering parameter-efficient solution for adapting to new environments.

papers.title: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Continuous Navigation via Memory-Augmented Kalman Filtering
papers.contribution: With 10% training data fine-tuning, clearly outperforms baselines and regulates drift accumulation.

papers.title: Motion Planning in Compressed Representation Spaces
papers.contribution: Enables closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent scenario synthesis on nuPlan and Waymo Open Motion Dataset without task-specific training.

papers.title: N2M: Bridging Navigation and Manipulation by Learning Pose Preference from Rollout
papers.contribution: N2M achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming policy-aware alternatives with broad applicability, strong generalization, and remarkable data efficiency.

papers.title: NOMAD: Lifelong Trajectory Planning via Non-Parametric Bayesian Memory-Adaptive Diffusion Experts
papers.contribution: Achieves 9.4% improvement in interPlan score on nuPlan long-tail scenarios with positive backward transfer during continual learning.

papers.title: OmniNav: A Unified Framework for Prospective Exploration and Visual-Language Navigation
papers.contribution: Handles multiple navigation paradigms within single architecture with high precision waypoint prediction supporting real-world deployment up to 5 Hz.

papers.title: Pairwise is Not Enough: Hypergraph Neural Networks for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
papers.contribution: HMAGAT achieves state-of-the-art results with only 1M parameters trained on 100x less data than competing methods, while empirically demonstrating that hypergraph representations mitigate attention dilution.

papers.title: Plan-R1: Safe and Feasible Trajectory Planning as Language Modeling
papers.contribution: Aligns planning with safety principles while discarding undesirable patterns, maintaining human-like behaviors on nuPlan benchmark.

papers.title: RoCA: Robust Cross-Domain End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Strong domain generalization and adaptation without extra inference computation, significantly outperforming direct finetuning on cross-domain scenarios.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Gaussian Map for Vision-Language Navigation
